name: [UPD] Hire a Fisher 🧟‍♀️
desc:
Welcome to ‘Hire a Fisher’! 🎣

How to Play:

🛒 Buy a fisherman in the shop

⚓ Place your fisherman on the dock

🐟 Collect the fish they’ve caught automatically

💰 Sell the fish to earn tons of cents

Note: This game is still under development and may have bugs. If you spot any bugs, please let us know on the Community Wall!

Thanks for playing, and have fun :DDD
